meta.notes: The barracks: two wings of small rooms, each off a gallery that looks onto the yard through unglazed openings, joined by a link block with the mess hall. Eleven defenders in three squads (a wing each and the link), seven doors and an arch in from outside. For the four man squad. One floor, box geometry only, the office's rectangle and kit.
